source.check: names from the newspaper's text, which reads cleanly; not checked on the page image

note: Only four candidates were nominated for the nine seats, and they were returned unopposed: Thomas Mallon (chairman), Bernard Feighan and B. Woods (old members) and M. Smyth, junior (new). Under the Local Government Board's rule the five remaining seats fell to the members of the old council who had received the most votes at the last election, in 1914; which members took them is not recorded here. Thirteen of the old members, all Nationalists except one Sinn Féin member, are listed in the report.
